sloka: तम् एवम् अभिभाषन्तम् आकाशैव निर्मलः ।भरतः श्लक्ष्णया वाचा गुहम् वचनम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-८५-८॥
transliteration: tam evam abhibhāṣantam ākāśaiva nirmalaḥ ।bharataḥ ślakṣṇayā vācā guham vacanam abravīt ॥2-85-8॥

translations.english: When he heard Guha thus speaking, Bharata who was as tranquil as the sky, said to him in a gentle voice.
